# MS MAIN GATE

Enhance your property's entrance with this beautifully designed decorative metal main gate from Harichand Steel. This main gate features a matte charcoal finish, elegant vertical metal panels, premium golden Greek Key detailing, and a beautifully crafted circular ornamental centrepiece. The main gate brings a modern look to any residential or commercial property.

Designed with care and attention to detail, this main gate combines striking beauty with a durable structure. The golden decorative strip stands out against the grey finish, creating a stunning contrast. This main gate is a choice for homeowners who want a premium entrance design.

Harichand Steel has been manufacturing customized steel gates, main gates, grills, railings, and premium entrance solutions since 2004. Their expertise ensures every main gate is built to last and delivered with style.
